statements.notes:
Enhanced performance with delicious creatine chews
Muscle Tech Creatine Chews are the perfect addition to your supplement stack.
Increase Muscle power
Boost strength
Enhance performance
Each serving (3 chewable tablets) provides 3 g of Creapure creatine monohydrate in a tasty and convenient candy-like chew!
Winning taste

More power & recovery
Creatine helps to rapidly enhance your muscle cells' ability to regenerate adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the body's primary source of anaerobic energy. With higher ATP levels, you'll be able to train harder and recover faster - allowing you to do more work in less time.
Test subjects gained over 4x more lean muscle
In a 12-week study, test subjects taking the same amount of creatine in two servings of Creatine Chews gained over four times more lean muscle than subjects using a placebo(7.12 vs.1.30 lbs).

No shaker, No powder, no mess
MuscleTech Creatine Chews are delicious and convenient, so not you can take your creatine on-the-go and leave the mess behind!
